cards.text: Jeremiah the prophet is still bringing the LORD's word about Babylon. Now the call goes out: raise a banner in the land and blow the ram's horn among the nations! That ram's horn is the original group chat notification, friend, and EVERY nation just got pinged.

cards.question: The banner is up and the ram's horn is blowing among the nations. What are the nations being prepared for?

cards.text: Three kingdoms get summoned by name, Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz, and horses come up like swarming locusts. Friend, when the horses show up like THAT, it's not a cavalry anymore, it's a WEATHER ALERT.

cards.question: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz aren't the only ones called up against Babylon. Which kings get prepared for battle too, with their governors and officials?

cards.text: Then the earth itself quakes and writhes. Friend, I've seen a mixer on high speed walk itself right across my counter, but never a whole PLANET.

cards.question: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD's intentions against Babylon stand.
The LORD has plans for the land of Babylon. What will those plans make it?

answers.text: A province ruled by the Medes
A city of refuge for nations

cards.text: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting and just sit in their strongholds, their strength all used up. Friend, I sat in a junk drawer for YEARS, and my whole stronghold was a takeout menu.

cards.question: While Babylon's warriors sit in their strongholds, the bars of her ___ are broken.

cards.text: Babylon's homes are on fire, and the couriers come running to the king, one after another after another. Friend, when your phone buzzes eight times in a row, you put the cookie DOWN and you read.

cards.question: Messenger after messenger races to the king of Babylon. What news are they carrying?

answers.text: His city has been captured from end to end
His army has won the battle at the walls
His enemies have turned around and gone home

cards.text: Then the fords get seized and the marshes are set on fire. Friend, that's waking up to find both bridges closed AND a detour sign on the back road.

cards.question: With the fords seized and the marshes set on fire, Babylon's soldiers stay calm.

cards.text: Then the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, paints a picture: the Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled. Friend, I've pressed a LOT of dough flat in my day, but this is a whole other level.

cards.question: Babylon is like a threshing floor being trampled. The LORD says in just a little while, her ___ time will come.

cards.text: Now a new voice speaks up. It's Jerusalem, the dweller of Zion, and she's got something to say about Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

cards.question: Jerusalem speaks up about Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. How does she say he has treated her?

answers.text: He has devoured and crushed her
He has protected and fed her
He has freed and honored her

cards.text: She says he swallowed her like a monster, filled his belly with her delicacies and vomited her out. Friend, Jerusalem is NOT holding back.

cards.question: "May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon ___," says the dweller of Zion.

cards.text: Jerusalem has said her piece. Now the LORD answers her.

cards.question: After Jerusalem speaks, what does the LORD say He will do for her?

answers.text: Plead her case and take vengeance for her
Leave her case for the nations to settle
Tell her to make peace with Babylon

cards.text: Then the LORD says He'll dry up Babylon's sea and make her springs run dry. Friend, I can't even keep one batch of dough from drying out on the counter, and here's a whole SEA running dry.

cards.question: The LORD says Babylon will become a heap of ___, a haunt for jackals.

cards.text: The LORD says Babylon's people will roar together like young lions and growl like lion cubs. While they're flushed with heat, He says He'll serve them a feast.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll serve Babylon's people a feast and make them drunk so they revel. What comes after the feast?

answers.text: They fall asleep and never wake up
They wake up and turn back to God
They march out to fight the Medes

cards.text: He says He'll bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats. Then the words turn to Babylon: "How Sheshach has been captured!"

cards.question: Babylon, once the praise of all the earth, becomes a horror among the nations.

cards.text: Then the sea comes up over Babylon, and she's covered in turbulent waves. Friend, that's not a city by the water anymore, that's a city UNDER it.

cards.question: Babylon's cities will become a green land full of fields.

cards.text: Last, the LORD says He'll punish Bel, a false god of Babylon, and make him spew out what he swallowed. Friend, that's the coworker who swore he never took your stapler handing back the stapler AND the tape.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll punish Bel, a false god of Babylon. What does He say about the nations streaming to Bel?

answers.text: They stream to him even more
They stream to him from farther away

cards.question: Even after all this, the wall of Babylon will still be standing.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this batch down for now. Trust me, friend, the LORD's message against Babylon isn't finished yet.
